holdHelp: A safety hold preserves the physical commitment while an unknown financial result is reconciled. It does not mark payment or release the watch.
sample: Sample watch content. Reservations use the live database.
title: Reserve your watch
intro: One physical watch. One buyer reservation. Confirm a current quote before continuing.
signInBody: Your reservations and private requests belong only to your signed-in profile.
reserved: This watch already has a commitment
fenced: This watch is fenced against another sale
auction: This watch uses another sale mode. Direct Buy Now is unavailable.
attemptCreated: Simulated payment attempt created — not yet paid
confirmedPayment: Signed simulated payment confirmed — funds held
notificationPending: No payment clock until the buyer notice is durably available
deadline: Payment deadline (Beirut time; 48 hours before route selection)
paymentNotice: Simulated payments only. A reservation is not a paid order. Signed exact confirmation posts held funds once; no real charge or seller payout.
uncertain: Not confirmed. Keep this page open and retry the same operation; do not create another payment attempt.
noPermission: Access denied. Current permissions and ownership are checked on the server.
stale: The watch changed. Reload its current availability before a new attempt.
unavailable: A required service is unavailable. No reservation is confirmed.
invalid: Check the supplied references and fields.
denied: The watch cannot be reserved with this request.
watch_unavailable: Another buyer or sale already holds this physical watch. No payment authority was granted.
self_purchase: You cannot buy your own watch.
quote_expired: This quote has expired. Obtain a current quote first.
quote_mismatch: This quote does not match your profile and current listing revision.
quote_invalid: A current quote belonging to you is required.
sale_mode_unavailable: Direct Buy Now is unavailable for this sale mode.
watch_unknown: This physical watch has not been registered for sale.
idempotency_conflict: This operation reference was used with different details.
quoteHelp: Use an exact quote issued by Pricing for this listing and your profile.
intakeNote: Only currently authorized intake staff can record actual custody facts. This never authorizes final handover.
intakeSaved: Pre-release intake recorded. Not final handover.
